From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Cho <amanda.cho@novushealth.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@novushealth.com>

Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Weekly Checkpoint — Vendor onboarding gating: MSA redlines & order form items

Team / Amanda / Carlos —

Quick MAP checkpoint for where we stand on the legal / procurement gating items for the Novus Health close. Short bullets, owners and asks so we can move to order-form execution by the end of next week.

Open items (high level):
- MSA redlines: Novus provided comments last Friday. We need a consolidated response and a final internal sign-off from Legal. (Attachment: Novus_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) — owner: Laura B. — target: 2027-06-30
- Order form: confirm billing contact, payment terms (net 45 vs net 30), and SKU/usage caps. (Attachment: NOVUS_OrderForm_v1.xlsx) — owner: Karthik I. — target: 2027-07-01
- Vendor setup: supplier onboarding in our billing portal and SSO provisioning (IT). Need procurement paperwork from Novus and final billing contact details — owner: Sean G. / Carlos R. — target: 2027-07-02
- SOC2 evidence & data retention: Amanda to confirm which artifacts Novus needs (we can provide SOC2 report excerpt and audit contact). — owner: Hannah S. — target: 2027-07-01

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura to share consolidated MSA response (tracked changes + commentary) by EOD 6/30.
2) Karthik to update order form with agreed payment terms and return to Novus by 7/1.
3) Sean to start vendor onboarding request ticket in Coupa and share vendor code when available.
4) Hannah will prepare the SOC2 package and share a link to the secure drive.

Can we confirm a short 30-min close cadence on Tues 6/29 at 10:00 PT to walk redlines and order form? If that works, I’ll send calendar invite.

Attachments: Novus_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf, NOVUS_OrderForm_v1.xlsx, Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.docx

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Deals 
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP Weekly Checkpoint — Vendor onboarding gating: MSA redlines & order form items

Thanks Hannah —

Appreciate the clear list. I reviewed the MSA and attached a PDF with inline comments (Novus_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf). Two high-level asks from Legal:
- We’d like to add a 45-day cure period for termination for convenience (see section 7.2).
- Clarify data retention clause to ensure alignment with HIPAA-adjacent requirements — we can accept the SOC2 excerpt but need a named audit contact.

On payment terms, procurement prefers net-45. Carlos will confirm the billing contact and procurement paperwork — he’s looping in Finance to expedite vendor creation.

We can do the 6/29 10:00 PT check. Please send the invite.

Amanda Cho
Head of Legal
Novus Health

Subject: Re: MAP Weekly Checkpoint — Vendor onboarding gating: MSA redlines & order form items

Laura — looping you as owner on MSA response. Can you do a short cover memo that: 1) accepts X of Novus’s redlines, 2) proposes alternate language for the cure period (we prefer 30 days), and 3) flags any commercial risk we need Sales signoff on?

Laura, suggested breakdown:
- Itemize each redline in a two-column table (Novus request / our proposed response).
- Highlight 1–2 high-risk asks (e.g., unlimited liability carve-outs or overly broad data usage) for exec review.

Sean — please start the vendor onboarding ticket with Procurement now. Include expected billing contact: finance@novushealth.com (placeholder) — Carlos please confirm actual contact. When vendor code is created, share here so we can attach to the order form.

Hannah — I’ll update the order form to net-45 and include a clause for initial usage caps (to avoid accidental overages) and circulate before 7/1.

I created a quick meeting agenda doc and will add it to the Drive link after Hannah uploads the SOC2 excerpt. Proposed agenda for 6/29 10:00 PT:
- 10 min: Recap open legal redlines + Laura’s proposed responses
- 10 min: Order form & billing terms (Karthik)
- 5 min: Vendor setup next steps (Sean / Carlos)
- 5 min: Wrap / assign final action owners

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
